official_sources.title: GDAL COG validator
official_sources.finding: GDAL 3.13 provides gdal driver cog validate; full-check can verify strip/tile leading and trailer bytes, with local files checked extensively by default while remote full-check is not automatic.
official_sources.limitation: COG structural validity does not prove target parcel lineage, pixel values or cryptographic byte identity.

official_sources.title: OGC Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF standard
official_sources.finding: OGC COG 1.0 formalizes TIFF tiling/reduced-resolution organization, GeoTIFF georeferencing and HTTP Range delivery so clients can access only required byte ranges.
official_sources.limitation: Efficient partial access must not be confused with complete immutable-file verification.

official_sources.title: GDAL COG driver
official_sources.finding: GDAL COG creation can generate overviews, reproject when requested and alter representation under some compression choices; GeoTIFF 1.1 is selected when vertical/3D CRS content requires it.
official_sources.limitation: A derived COG can be structurally valid while differing from the native authoritative raster; terminal evidence must remain bound to approved source bytes.

official_sources.title: OGC COG full-resolution georeference requirements
official_sources.finding: COG full-resolution IFDs must carry georeference data using ModelTiepointTag, ModelPixelScaleTag and GeoKeyDirectoryTag; reduced-resolution geometry derives from the full-resolution subfile.
official_sources.limitation: Overview georeference consistency does not authorize overview values as terminal native elevation samples.

official_sources.title: OGC GeoTIFF 1.1 standard
official_sources.finding: GeoTIFF 1.1 formalizes georeferencing and vertical CRS encoding, including VerticalGeoKey ID 4096, and aligns CRS identifiers with the EPSG dataset.
official_sources.limitation: A vertical CRS key proves encoded metadata only when it matches authoritative source/product lineage and runtime interpretation.

official_sources.title: GDAL GeoTIFF driver georeferencing and nodata
official_sources.finding: GDAL GTiff can source georeferencing from internal GeoTIFF or sidecars with configurable priority; nodata may live in TIFFTAG_GDAL_NODATA or PAM sidecars, and internal/external masks can change validity interpretation.
official_sources.limitation: Replay must freeze allowed georeference sources and include every relevant sidecar digest.

official_sources.title: GDAL affine geotransform tutorial
official_sources.finding: GDAL defines the six-coefficient affine pixel/line to georeferenced coordinate transform; pixel (0,0) is the upper-left corner and the first pixel center is at (0.5,0.5).
official_sources.limitation: Affine coefficients alone do not establish PixelIsArea/PixelIsPoint semantics or parcel membership.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster dataset inspection
official_sources.finding: gdal raster info reports driver, dimensions, CRS, geotransform, datatype, block size, nodata, overviews, unit and optional pixel checksum; approximate statistics may use overviews or subsets.
official_sources.limitation: Reported checksum is not a cryptographic file digest and approximate statistics are not exact extrema evidence.

official_sources.title: GDALChecksumImage definition
official_sources.finding: GDALChecksumImage returns only a 16-bit checksum and converts floating-point values to 32-bit integer so decimal portions do not affect it.
official_sources.limitation: GDAL pixel checksum cannot establish immutable byte identity or exact floating-point equality; SHA-256/byte digest remains separately required.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster scale and offset semantics
official_sources.finding: GDAL defines decoded units as raw*scale+offset and states RasterIO/ReadBlock do not automatically apply scale/offset; application code must do so explicitly.
official_sources.limitation: Scale/offset decoding still requires proven band unit, nodata/mask handling and target-cell identity.

official_sources.title: GDAL virtual file system remote range access
official_sources.finding: /vsicurl/ relies on HTTP Range and caching to read remote datasets piece-wise; cached content can be explicitly cleared for resources that may change during execution.
official_sources.limitation: Partial cached reads cannot substitute for whole-object immutable digest when byte identity is an acceptance requirement.

official_sources.title: GDAL band mask validity model
official_sources.finding: GDAL masks use zero for invalid/nodata and non-zero for valid pixels and unify explicit masks with nodata/alpha-derived validity.
official_sources.limitation: Actual mask source, flags and sidecar/internal storage must be captured from the target dataset.
